title: Creamy Lemon Chicken Fettuccine with Peas
changes_from_base: Dried fettuccine replaces handmade egg pasta, tossed with a quick lemon cream sauce, seared chicken strips, peas and basil.
summary: Fettuccine in a light lemon cream sauce with seared chicken strips, sweet peas, Parmesan and basil.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 350 g), in 5 mm strips
fine sea salt or table salt
fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (0.5%)
ingredients.note: about 3.25 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Pat the strips dry and season with salt and pepper. Melt the butter in the pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken about 3 min, turning, until no longer pink and 74 °C. Move to a plate.

steps.title: Lemon cream
steps.text: Add the garlic to the empty pan for 30 s, then the cream, lemon zest and juice. Simmer 3-5 min until slightly thickened, then take off the heat and cover.

steps.title: Pasta and peas
steps.text: Boil the fettuccine in 4 litres salted water until nearly al dente, adding the peas for the last minute. Save a mug of the water, drain and return to the pot.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the lemon cream, Parmesan, basil and chicken and toss together, adding splashes of the water until silky. Serve straight away.

tips: Slice the chicken thinly so it cooks in minutes.
Add the pasta water slowly; the sauce thickens as it stands.
Frozen peas go straight into the pasta water, no need to thaw.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
